name: Otto AI
summary: Workspace for people and agents with crypto market intelligence, onchain execution and agent tools; its HTTP API lets an agent discover an endpoint, pay with x402 and check the result and receipt. The project has its own token ($OTTO).

overview.text: Otto AI presents market intelligence, research and on-chain execution tools, with focused mini agents and MCP or x402 access for builders. It lists tools for yield comparison, swaps, bridging and research, plus 71 catalogued x402 endpoints. Its $18.3 million transaction figure is explicitly historical marketplace-reported gross value observed 7 September 2026, including trading and service-fee flows from an agent retired in October. It is not current revenue. Interaction and wallet totals are operator reports, not verified unique people or autonomous agents, and yield tools do not promise investment returns.
